name: native_host
description: Manages a DuploCloud native host — an AWS EC2 instance provisioned inside a workspace environment.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace this host belongs to.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the host. Letters, numbers, and hyphens; must start with a letter or number. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment this host is provisioned in.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group this host belongs to. Provides the AWS account/region context.

attributes.name: subnet_id
attributes.description: ID of the subnet to launch the host in. Leave unset to auto-select the first subnet of the chosen subnet_type. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: os_platform
attributes.description: OS platform: 0 = Linux, 1 = Windows. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: disk_size_gb
attributes.description: Root EBS volume size in GiB (20-16384, gp3).

attributes.name: enable_os_disk_encryption
attributes.description: Whether the root EBS volume is encrypted at rest.

attributes.name: os_disk_encryption_key
attributes.description: KMS key ARN used to encrypt the root volume. Leave unset to use the resource group's default key.

attributes.name: metadata_service_option
attributes.description: Instance metadata service mode. V2Only requires IMDSv2 and disables IMDSv1 (recommended).

attributes.name: metadata_hop_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of network hops for instance metadata service requests.

attributes.name: subnet_type
attributes.description: Subnet tier used when subnet_id is auto-selected. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the scopes attached to this host.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Key/value tags applied to the host. Platform ownership tags are added automatically.

attributes.name: instance_type
attributes.description: EC2 instance type (e.g. t3a.small). Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: ebs_optimized
attributes.description: Whether the instance is EBS-optimized (higher IOPS/throughput on supported instance types).

attributes.name: image_id
attributes.description: AMI ID to launch (ami-...). Leave unset to use the default AMI for the selected OS platform.

attributes.name: user_data
attributes.description: Base64-encoded user data script run on first boot.

attributes.name: block_device_mappings
attributes.description: Block device mappings (root and additional volumes).

attributes.name: device_name
attributes.description: Device name (e.g. /dev/xvda).

attributes.name: no_device
attributes.description: Set to suppress a device that would otherwise be exposed by the AMI.

attributes.name: ebs
attributes.description: EBS volume configuration for this device.

attributes.name: volume_size
attributes.description: Volume size in GiB.

attributes.name: volume_type
attributes.description: EBS volume type (e.g. gp3).

attributes.name: delete_on_termination
attributes.description: Whether the volume is deleted when the instance terminates.

attributes.name: iops
attributes.description: Provisioned IOPS for the volume.

attributes.name: throughput
attributes.description: Throughput in MiB/s for the volume.

attributes.name: encrypted
attributes.description: Whether the volume is encrypted.

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ARN used to encrypt the volume.

attributes.name: snapshot_id
attributes.description: Snapshot ID to create the volume from.

attributes.name: instance_id
attributes.description: AWS EC2 instance ID of the provisioned host.

attributes.name: private_ip_address
attributes.description: Private IP address of the host.

attributes.name: public_ip_address
attributes.description: Public IP address of the host, if any.

attributes.name: live_state
attributes.description: Current live state of the EC2 instance (e.g. running, stopped).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Provisioning status of the host.

attributes.name: native_host_id
attributes.description: ID of this native host, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: sub_status
attributes.description: Additional provisioning status detail.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the host was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the host was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
